active_boundary: one batch_id shared by lineage_batch, lineage_program_state, lineage_edge, lineage_business_edge, and lineage_issue
invariants: A successful active snapshot has one shared batch_id across formal direct lineage and audit facts.
ProgramPhysicalDAG is the runtime physical fact graph: TMP, cycles, self-reference and orphan branches remain available to audit/materialization.
dwp.lineage_edge stores direct ProgramPhysicalDAG PhysicalEdge rows and may contain TMP endpoints.
dwp.lineage_business_edge stores the existing LineageEdge semantic: program-scoped TMP collapse produces formal direct endpoints and stops at the first formal asset boundary.
TMP endpoints are forbidden in dwp.lineage_business_edge; TMP may remain in dwp.lineage_edge.
A fact is active only when its is_active flag and its joined lineage_batch.is_active flag are true.
A row_key is unique per physical row and may contain batch_id; stable edge_key and other stable identity keys are batch-independent.
A partial snapshot has no disappearance authority outside its declared scope.
An unverified TMP collapse/materialization failure fails closed and cannot replace the previous active snapshot.
A successful empty snapshot is still a published active batch with zero physical and business edge rows.
The smoke schema defers database constraints; the writer repeats row_key and stable-identity duplicate validation for every fact table before active switch.
TMP rename, physical route, evidence order, source hash, or pipeline version changes do not update formal business-edge last_changed_at when its stable direct identity is unchanged.
Retention deletes only complete retired partitions beyond the configured horizon; active and rollback-window snapshots remain protected.

states.meaning: Rows are being inserted and validated inside the publish transaction; readers must not see them as current.
The five tables passed same-batch validation and the snapshot is the sole current projection.
Historical rows remain readable by explicit batch_id but do not participate in current queries.

cases.input: FULL complete snapshot with zero programs and zero physical edges
cases.program_physical_dag_result: zero programs and zero runtime physical edges
cases.active_result: new batch is active with edge_count=0

cases.input: ProgramSource build, audit and existing Phase 5 TMP collapse complete
cases.program_physical_dag_result: all direct physical edges, including TMP endpoints, cycles and orphan facts, remain in the runtime DAG
cases.lineage_edge_result: direct physical rows from ProgramPhysicalDAG, including TMP endpoints
cases.issue_result: audit issues, if any, use the same batch_id
cases.active_result: lineage_edge and issue rows switch active with program state in one batch
cases.business_edge_result: formal direct LineageEdge rows after existing program-scoped TMP collapse
cases.physical_edge_result: all direct physical edges, including TMP endpoints, are written to dwp.lineage_edge

cases.input: A -> TMP1 -> TMP2 -> B within one program, where A and B are formal DatasetIdentity values
cases.program_physical_dag_result: A -> TMP1 -> TMP2 -> B is retained as runtime physical facts
cases.lineage_edge_result: three dwp.lineage_edge direct rows retain A -> TMP1 -> TMP2 -> B
cases.issue_result: no transitive edge beyond B is emitted
cases.active_result: the collapsed formal direct fact is published with the same batch_id
cases.business_edge_result: one dwp.lineage_business_edge row A -> B; neither endpoint is TMP
cases.physical_edge_result: three dwp.lineage_edge direct rows retain A -> TMP1 -> TMP2 -> B

cases.input: A -> FORMAL_B -> TMP -> FORMAL_C within one program
cases.program_physical_dag_result: all four runtime nodes and three direct physical edges remain available
cases.lineage_edge_result: three dwp.lineage_edge direct rows retain every physical hop
cases.issue_result: no guessed transitive edge is emitted
cases.active_result: both formal direct facts use the same batch_id
cases.business_edge_result: A -> FORMAL_B and FORMAL_B -> FORMAL_C; A -> FORMAL_C is forbidden
cases.physical_edge_result: three dwp.lineage_edge direct rows retain all physical hops

cases.input: Physical graph contains a classified orphan/cycle/self-reference or unresolved path with no safe formal direct edge
cases.program_physical_dag_result: physical facts remain in the runtime DAG for audit and diagnosis
cases.lineage_edge_result: physical rows remain available; no guessed business endpoint is emitted
cases.issue_result: same-batch audit issue explains the classified negative result
cases.active_result: publish is allowed only after the existing materialization result is complete and deterministic
cases.business_edge_result: affected formal direct edge is absent; no guessed TMP/formal endpoint is emitted
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Physical build and audit succeed but existing TMP collapse/materialization raises, exceeds a controlled limit, or cannot prove a complete result
cases.program_physical_dag_result: may exist only in memory or inside a rolled-back candidate transaction
cases.issue_result: failure belongs to run observability; no half-active issue fact is published
cases.active_result: previous successful snapshot remains complete and active
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Insert, validation, count check, stable-key check, or active switch fails
cases.issue_result: candidate issue rows rollback with the batch

cases.input: Two candidate program states share environment/source_profile/program_name
cases.issue_result: validation error, not a silently merged program
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Two LineageEdge rows in one batch share edge_key
cases.program_physical_dag_result: candidate input may be valid but duplicate direct facts are not merged silently
cases.lineage_edge_result: candidate rejected; duplicate physical stable identity is not silently merged
cases.business_edge_result: candidate rejected; repeated physical-path evidence must be aggregated into one formal direct row
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: PARTIAL replay scopes profile_A and does not read profile_B
cases.program_physical_dag_result: profile_A is rebuilt/rebased; profile_B runtime-derived facts are outside the replay scope
cases.lineage_edge_result: profile_A is rebuilt/rebased; profile_B formal direct facts are copied to the new candidate
cases.issue_result: issues outside profile_A are not deleted
cases.active_result: one new active batch contains both profiles without merging their program keys
cases.deletion_authority: profile_A only if explicitly complete; never profile_B
cases.business_edge_result: profile_A is rebuilt/rebased; profile_B formal direct facts are copied to the new candidate
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Historical batch N-1 and current active batch N both contain a similar formal endpoint
cases.program_physical_dag_result: historical runtime inputs are not used by the current query
cases.lineage_edge_result: current query joins active lineage_batch and filters the lineage_edge active flag
cases.issue_result: historical issues are excluded from current projection
cases.business_edge_result: current business query joins active lineage_batch and filters dwp.lineage_business_edge
cases.physical_edge_result: current query joins active lineage_batch and filters dwp.lineage_edge

cases.input: Partial or limited replay omits a previously active program
cases.program_physical_dag_result: omitted program physical facts are not rebuilt or deleted outside an explicitly complete scope
cases.lineage_edge_result: omitted program formal direct facts are rebased unless inside an explicitly complete scope
cases.issue_result: omitted program issues are rebased outside complete scope
cases.active_result: absence is not interpreted as deletion outside scope
cases.business_edge_result: omitted program formal direct facts are rebased unless inside an explicitly complete scope
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: FULL complete scan of environment/profile scope omits a previously active program
cases.program_physical_dag_result: program is absent from the new runtime input in that scope
cases.lineage_edge_result: program formal direct facts are absent from the new active candidate in that scope
cases.issue_result: old issue rows remain historical; current issue projection follows the candidate
cases.active_result: scoped disappearance is effective; historical batch remains readable
cases.business_edge_result: program formal direct facts are absent from the new active candidate in that scope
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: source_hash is non-empty and equal to active state; pipeline_version is equal
cases.program_physical_dag_result: existing runtime-derived facts are not rebuilt for the unchanged program
cases.lineage_edge_result: formal direct facts are rebased to the new batch without rebuilding
cases.issue_result: state and issues are rebased according to lifecycle rules
cases.active_result: stable keys stay equal; row_keys change because batch_id changes
cases.business_edge_result: formal direct facts are rebased to the new batch without rebuilding
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Same ProgramIdentity but source_hash changes or is unavailable
cases.program_physical_dag_result: physical DAG, audit and Phase 5 materialization rebuild is required
cases.lineage_edge_result: formal direct facts rebuild from the new materialization result; no one-layer reuse
cases.issue_result: new Issue #36 fact/policy projection is reconciled in the same candidate
cases.active_result: program_key and edge_key may remain stable; evidence metadata may change without changing formal identity
cases.business_edge_result: formal direct facts rebuild from the new materialization result; no one-layer reuse
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.program_physical_dag_result: physical DAG, audit and materialization rebuild because semantic rules may change
cases.lineage_edge_result: formal direct facts rebuild from the new materialization result
cases.issue_result: fact and policy evidence is regenerated using the CLOSED Issue #36 projection contract
cases.active_result: no reuse based on hash alone
cases.business_edge_result: formal direct facts rebuild from the new materialization result
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: TMP node name changes while formal direct source and target stay equal
cases.program_physical_dag_result: physical node/edge labels change in the runtime DAG
cases.lineage_edge_result: physical edge keys follow the changed TMP labels; formal business identity remains stable
cases.issue_result: no basename-only merge; diagnostics remain tied to physical evidence
cases.active_result: formal direct identity is stable; last_changed_at remains unchanged
cases.business_edge_result: edge_key stays equal for the same formal direct identity; bounded collapse evidence may change and never exposes TMP as an endpoint
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

cases.input: Physical route changes but formal direct source/target remain equal
cases.program_physical_dag_result: new physical direct facts are present in the runtime DAG
cases.lineage_edge_result: one same edge_key is rebuilt; current bounded evidence is refreshed without adding a raw physical DWS row
cases.issue_result: unsafe or incomplete materialization is diagnostic and may fail closed
cases.active_result: formal direct identity remains stable; last_changed_at remains unchanged
cases.business_edge_result: one same business_edge_key is rebuilt and bounded evidence is refreshed
cases.physical_edge_result: new direct physical rows replace the current batch projection

cases.input: A previously disappeared ProgramIdentity appears again in a later complete scope
cases.program_physical_dag_result: new observation is rebuilt; old runtime-derived facts remain represented by history where applicable
cases.lineage_edge_result: new candidate rows use the current batch and safe formal direct materialization
cases.issue_result: old issue history is not silently mutated
cases.active_result: restore is not rename inference; first_seen follows #38 restore semantics
cases.business_edge_result: new candidate rows use the current batch and safe formal direct materialization
cases.physical_edge_result: physical direct rows follow ProgramPhysicalDAG.edges; TMP endpoints remain representable

notes: lineage_edge is the physical direct projection and may contain TMP endpoints.
lineage_business_edge is the existing formal direct LineageEdge projection; the writer does not re-run TMP collapse.
edge_count is the physical lineage_edge count; the batch schema has no physical_edge_count or business_edge_count aliases (publish results may report business_edge_count separately).
